messages:
priya: PR #459 (migration guide + SDK snippets) is blocked. We need a runtime-confirmed default for `compat_mode` before we decide whether snippets should set it explicitly. Also linkcheck is failing.

alex: quick answer: hosted API default = true (preserve legacy semantics). This default is planned for deprecation in a future release. Dedicated/private installs can be operator-configured and may differ.

maria: thanks. Docs recommendation: show explicit `compat_mode` in examples to avoid surprises during customers' migrations.

sam-runtime: agreed. Also call out the behavior change: compat_mode=true uses the legacy context-trimming heuristic (keeps older prefixes, increases token counts); compat_mode=false uses a sliding token-window to reduce tokens and improve throughput.

priya: Sam, can you provide a short, user-friendly sentence we can paste under the migration note about trimming?

sam-runtime: paste: "When compat_mode is true, the service preserves legacy context-trimming (which may retain older conversation parts and raise token usage); when false, a newer token-window trimming reduces token usage and favors throughput."

priya: thanks. alex: can you give a single sentence about defaults we can paste?

alex: paste: "Note: For hosted customers, compat_mode defaults to true to preserve legacy request semantics; we recommend passing compat_mode explicitly during migration because this default is scheduled for deprecation. Dedicated/private defaults are operator-controlled and may differ."

maria: CI: doc-bot reports broken anchors in /migration/compatibility.md (#sdk-examples, #legacy-anchors). I'll patch anchors.

doc-bot: linkcheck ERROR: 2 broken anchors in /migration/compatibility.md -> #sdk-examples, #legacy-anchors. Preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-459 (linkcheck will re-run after push)

priya: plan: I'll update the guide with alex's and sam's lines, switch SDK snippets to include explicit compat_mode, fix anchors, push, wait for linkcheck + alex +1. Hold merge until then.

alex: ping me when preview is green and I'll approve.

maria: noted, will do anchor fixes now. :thumbsup:
